activity: 1. Development of the national conservation plan
progress: IWC Scientific Committee agreed a draft plan to assess all populations; assessment starts at the 2026 meeting.
difficulties: Insufficient funding and logistics; no abundance estimates for the Argentine FMAs (IVa–IVe); bycatch estimates outdated, especially in Argentina.

progress: International workshop in July 2025 with 45 participants; data received to start the IWC Comprehensive Assessment.
difficulties: Lack of funds; remaining workshops planned for the second and third quarters of 2026.

activity: 3. Addressing bycatch and other mitigation problems
progress: Updated mortality, strandings and bycatch information; fishers and researchers collaborating on mitigation in some FMAs.
difficulties: Weak enforcement in some FMAs; limited funds to extend mitigation trials; timing depends on national policies.
